title: Brown Brothers Harriman, Versailles reparations and Union Bank financing of Hitler

tellings.quote: in 1924 George Herbert Walker leaves Brown Brothers Herman sets up the the Union Bank of New York completely capitalized by the guy who are part of Brown Brothers Herman

plain: A guest named Dan Sheehan tells podcast host Jesse Michels a story that starts with the Treaty of Versailles, the peace deal after the First World War, and the payments it forced on Germany. He says that in 1924 George Herbert Walker left Brown Brothers Harriman, a New York bank, and set up the Union Bank of New York, funded entirely by people from that bank, and he links this money to the rise of Hitler, naming Robert Lansing, the brothers John Foster and Allen Dulles, and a German named Fritz Thyssen. If true, American bankers would have helped pay for Hitler's rise.
